swf_open_course.accept_text:
Out to the far turn and look at it. That is all I am asking for and it is more than I have done.

The darters have taken the north leg and they come off the ground fast enough to put a driver into the salt. Seven of them, and bring me resin from whatever is laying it, because I need to know whether the course is fouled or whether it is being BUILT ON.

There is a difference and the difference decides whether there is a race.

The drones that lay the resin work the Crust, south-west of town - not the course itself.

swf_mound_spitters.accept_text:
A spitter gets resin into a wound and the wound sets. Not closes - SETS, with the dirt still in it, and then I am cutting it open again in a fortnight.

Nine of them off the fence line, and I want four sacs still under pressure and four scorpid barbs to set against them. The barbs keep their venom wet out here when everything else dries. If I can work out why, I can work out how to keep a wound open.

It is not elegant medicine. It is the medicine available.

The fence line runs along the Mounds, east of Saltwheel.

swf_mound_queen.accept_text:
Go in at whichever mouth you like. They both get there, which is the thing I spent three years not knowing.

She is at the middle. The rippers on the way, and plates off the sentinels - and I want the plates because I want to see whether what guards her is made the same as what comes out to the fence.

I am not coming. I have one skill and it is standing on a fence counting, and down there there is nothing to count.

The Undercrust is a long way south of Saltwheel, under the far edge of the pan.
